The '''Wipe-3 data-purge grenade''' was a type of [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It provided a reliable method of data erasure by releasing a focused pulse that scrambled electronic data, usually without damaging the hardware. While physical destruction could sometimes be reversed by expert [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]], the Wipe-3 ensured data was irretrievable. It was a small, single-use device favored by [[Agent/Legends|agents]] who needed to securely purge sensitive information stored on electronic media.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wipe-3 data-purge grenade was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
